business_state.save_behavior: Save updates the active document in place; Save a copy and Export PDF create separate files.

business_state.print_behavior: 打印 submits all pages with the current print settings; 打印选中部分 overrides the page range.

business_state.file_name_input_binding: 文件名 sets the output filename; Directory and Folder name set paths; Template name selects a template.

business_state.discard_behavior: Discard changes reverts unsaved edits only; Delete file removes the file; Reset all files changes other files.

business_state.submission_behavior: Submit invoice sends the selected invoice to its configured recipient. Save invoice draft does not send. Submit quote creates a quote instead.

business_state.reservation_behavior: 确认预订 confirms the selected itinerary with the current traveler and fare; 加入收藏 only bookmarks it; 修改行程 changes the selection.

business_state.search_bindings: 商品搜索 queries the catalog; Order search queries existing orders; Search history queries prior search records.

business_state.pause_behavior: Pause subscription temporarily suspends the current subscription, retaining the account; Cancel subscription terminates it; Delete account removes the account.
